title: Authentication and role guard
business_value: Every other capability in the platform sits behind this guard; without it no role (customer, underwriter, policy editor, admin) can be told apart or kept out of data that is not theirs.
scope_in: POST /api/auth/login issuing a 1800s bearer JWT (HS256) keyed by email/password
GET /api/auth/me
a router-level auth dependency applied to every route except login and health
role enumeration CUSTOMER, UNDERWRITER, POLICY_EDITOR, ADMIN

acceptance_criteria.given: seeded user customer1@example.test with the correct password
acceptance_criteria.then: the response is 200 with expires_in 1800 and role CUSTOMER
it is 401 UNAUTHENTICATED with no token and the same body whether or not the email exists

acceptance_criteria.given: no Authorization header, or a token 1801 seconds old
acceptance_criteria.then: it is 401
it is 403 FORBIDDEN
every route except POST /api/auth/login and GET /health declares the auth dependency

title: Audit trail
business_value: A lender's underwriting decisions and overrides must be reconstructible after the fact; the audit row is the only record of who did what and when.
scope_in: append-only audit_log table with actor, role, action, entity, correlation_id
the nine audited actions (POLICY_CREATED, POLICY_APPROVED, DOCUMENT_VERIFIED, DOCUMENT_REJECTED, REVIEW_APPROVED, REVIEW_REJECTED, DECISION_OVERRIDDEN, DISBURSEMENT_RECORDED, EOD_RUN)
GET /api/audit filtered by entity_type/entity_id, ADMIN only
a database trigger that aborts UPDATE/DELETE on audit_log

depends_on.reason: audit rows need the authenticated actor and role

acceptance_criteria.given: UNDERWRITER user 3 performing an audited action on application 7
acceptance_criteria.then: one audit_log row has actor_user_id 3, actor_role UNDERWRITER, entity_type application, entity_id 7, a UTC occurred_at, and correlation_id equal to the response header

acceptance_criteria.when: any UPDATE or DELETE runs on audit_log
acceptance_criteria.then: the database aborts and the row is unchanged

acceptance_criteria.given: 3 audit rows for application 7 and 2 for application 8
acceptance_criteria.then: exactly 3 rows return in ascending id order

acceptance_criteria.given: an audited action that fails with a 409
acceptance_criteria.then: no audit row exists for it, because the audit write shares the action's transaction

title: JSON logs, correlation IDs, and redaction
business_value: Synthetic PII (PAN, Aadhaar) and document filenames must never leak into logs, and every request must be traceable end to end by a correlation ID.
scope_in: one structured JSON log line per request with ts/level/event/correlation_id/method/path/status/duration_ms
inbound X-Correlation-ID reuse/validation, generated UUID4 fallback, echoed response header
a redaction filter masking PAN/Aadhaar patterns and document filenames anywhere in a log record
the 500 error envelope with no stack trace in the response
scope_out: request/response body logging of any kind

acceptance_criteria.then: exactly one JSON log line has the keys ts, level, event, correlation_id, method, path, status, duration_ms

acceptance_criteria.given: no inbound X-Correlation-ID, or an inbound `req-12345678`, or an inbound `a b!`
acceptance_criteria.then: a missing header yields a UUID4 echoed in the response header and equal to the log's correlation_id, `req-12345678` is reused as-is, and `a b!` is replaced by a UUID4

acceptance_criteria.given: an application created with PAN ABCDE1234F and Aadhaar 1234 5678 9012
acceptance_criteria.when: all captured logs, including error paths, are scanned
acceptance_criteria.then: neither ABCDE1234F, 123456789012, nor 1234 5678 9012 appears

acceptance_criteria.given: a document upload with filename salary_slip_jan.pdf
acceptance_criteria.then: the document ID appears and the filename does not
the response is 500 with the error envelope and no stack trace, and the trace is logged as JSON through the redaction filter

title: Health, migrations, and architecture guards
business_value: Establishes the structural invariants the rest of the build is judged against: an unauthenticated readiness probe, tamper-evident migrations and policy files, a one-way layer order, and zero floating-point money.
scope_in: GET /health (public, under 1000ms once ready)
numbered SQL migrations applied once and recorded with a SHA-256 in schema_migrations
startup abort on a changed applied migration (MIGRATION_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH)
an automated layering test (types < config < repository < service < api < ui, one-way)
a static scan for float types/calls and REAL money columns
seeding users (F0) and policy version 1 as APPROVED

acceptance_criteria.when: GET /health is requested without a token
acceptance_criteria.then: it is 200 {"status":"ok"} in at most 1000 ms
none re-run and schema_migrations still has 3 rows with SHA-256 values
startup aborts with MIGRATION_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH and /health never returns 200

acceptance_criteria.given: the source tree under backend/src/truelend and frontend/src
acceptance_criteria.then: no module imports from a higher layer in the order types, config, repository, service, api, ui
it finds no float type, no float( call, and no REAL money column

title: Product catalog from the active policy
business_value: A customer must see the loan products and their thresholds before applying; the catalog is read live off whichever policy version is currently approved.
scope_in: GET /api/products returning the active version's PERSONAL/VEHICLE/EDUCATION thresholds and required_documents
startup verification that policy_v0001.json matches its stored SHA-256

depends_on.reason: the catalog requires a valid token
the catalog reads the seeded active policy

acceptance_criteria.then: exactly 3 products return (PERSONAL, VEHICLE, EDUCATION), each with policy_version 1

acceptance_criteria.when: the rule sets are compared pairwise
acceptance_criteria.then: each differs in at least one threshold (min_income is 25000.00, 30000.00, 20000.00)
required_documents has 3 entries for PERSONAL and 4 each for VEHICLE and EDUCATION
it is 401
startup aborts with POLICY_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH

title: Apply for a loan
business_value: The customer's first concrete action: creating a DRAFT application pinned to a product and generating the right document checklist for it.
scope_in: POST /api/applications creating a DRAFT with a per-product required-documents checklist (MISSING)
amount/tenure range validation against the active policy
PAN/Aadhaar format validation and masked display (pan_masked, aadhaar_masked)
ownership: another customer's application returns 404

depends_on.reason: apply validates amount/tenure against the active policy and builds the document checklist
apply is a CUSTOMER-only route

acceptance_criteria.when: they POST /api/applications with PERSONAL, amount "200000.00", tenure 24, age 30, income "60000.00", no flags, PAN ABCDE1234F, Aadhaar 123456789012
acceptance_criteria.then: it is 201 with id 1, status DRAFT, applicant_user_id 4

required_documents is ID_PROOF, ADDRESS_PROOF, SALARY_SLIP (each MISSING); a VEHICLE application lists 4 documents including VEHICLE_QUOTATION; an EDUCATION one includes ADMISSION_LETTER and FEE_STRUCTURE
it is 422 TENURE_OUT_OF_RANGE or 422 AMOUNT_OUT_OF_RANGE respectively
it is 422 VALIDATION_ERROR; a valid application returns pan_masked "******234F" and aadhaar_masked "********9012" and no raw values
it is 404

title: Upload documents and submit
business_value: An application only becomes decision-ready once the required documents are recorded and the customer submits, pinning the policy version used for underwriting.
scope_in: POST .../documents recording metadata only (type, filename), no file content
POST .../submit requiring every document UPLOADED or later, pinning the active policy version
re-upload of a REJECTED document resets it to UPLOADED
scope_out: real file storage, OCR, or virus scanning

depends_on.reason: upload and submit act on the created application and its document rows

acceptance_criteria.then: it is 201 and that document is UPLOADED with no file content stored
it is 422 DOCUMENT_TYPE_NOT_REQUIRED
it is 409 MISSING_DOCUMENTS with missing ["SALARY_SLIP"] and status stays DRAFT

acceptance_criteria.given: all 3 documents UPLOADED and the active version 1
acceptance_criteria.then: it is 200, status SUBMITTED, policy_version 1, and submitted_at set
it is 409 ALREADY_SUBMITTED

title: Apply wizard and verification queue UI
business_value: The two demo-critical screens on the customer and underwriter sides of document intake: a mobile-friendly apply wizard and a responsive verification queue.
scope_in: a three-step apply wizard (Product, Details, Documents and submit) with a progress indicator
inline range validation on the Details step
a verification queue that renders as a table on desktop and stacked cards on mobile, updating without a page reload
scope_out: real file upload UI beyond a stub form

depends_on.reason: the apply wizard calls these endpoints
the verification queue UI calls this endpoint

acceptance_criteria.then: a three-step flow (Product, Details, Documents and submit) shows one step at a time with a progress indicator and no horizontal scroll
an inline error shows "12-60 months" before they continue
a table lists documents; at 375x812 the same data shows as stacked cards; verifying one removes it without a page reload

title: Verification queue
business_value: An underwriter must be able to see all pending documents in one queue and clear each one, VERIFIED or REJECTED, with an audited reason.
scope_in: GET /api/verification-queue listing UPLOADED documents oldest first, paginated
POST /api/documents/{id}/verify with outcome and a 1-500 character reason
VERIFIED is final; only a REJECTED document can be replaced

depends_on.reason: the queue lists UPLOADED documents
verify/reject actions are audited

acceptance_criteria.then: 3 items return oldest first, each with document_id, application_id 1, and type

acceptance_criteria.when: user 3 POSTs {outcome:"VERIFIED", reason:"Name matches PAN record"}
acceptance_criteria.then: it is 200 VERIFIED, verified_by 3, an audit row DOCUMENT_VERIFIED is written, and the item leaves the queue
it is 200 REJECTED with the reason, an audit row DOCUMENT_REJECTED is written, and the application still reads SUBMITTED
it is 422 VALIDATION_ERROR and no audit row is written

acceptance_criteria.given: a CUSTOMER token, or an already VERIFIED document
acceptance_criteria.when: they GET the queue or POST verify, or verify is posted again
acceptance_criteria.then: it is 403 for the CUSTOMER token and 409 ALREADY_VERIFIED for the already-verified document

title: Credit-scoring stub
business_value: Underwriting needs a deterministic, explainable score to compare against policy thresholds, without any real bureau integration.
scope_in: a pure function score(age, income, credit_flags) -> integer
fixed formula: base 600 + age points + income points - flag penalties

acceptance_criteria.then: the score is 740

acceptance_criteria.given: age 30 with income "60000.00" and no flags, or age 30 with income "30000.00" and prior_default
acceptance_criteria.then: the first scores 680 and the second scores 500
all 100 scores are identical

acceptance_criteria.when: one input changes at a time
acceptance_criteria.then: age 40 gives 700, income "70000.00" gives 690, missed_payment_12m gives 620, thin_file gives 640, and prior_default gives 530

acceptance_criteria.given: age 18, income "0.00" and all three flags, or age 40 with income "150000.00" or "500000.00"
acceptance_criteria.then: the first scores 350 and both of the second case scores are 790

title: Underwriting decision with reason codes
business_value: Turns a submitted application into AUTO_APPROVE, AUTO_REJECT, or MANUAL_REVIEW using the policy version pinned at submission, with explainable reason codes.
scope_in: POST /api/applications/{id}/underwrite on a SUBMITTED application, callable once
rule order: income floor, age range, score thresholds
status mapping AUTO_APPROVE->APPROVED, AUTO_REJECT->REJECTED, MANUAL_REVIEW->MANUAL_REVIEW
ApplicationApproved event published in the same transaction on any transition to APPROVED

depends_on.reason: underwriting consumes the deterministic score
underwriting runs on a SUBMITTED application with a pinned policy version

acceptance_criteria.given: a submitted PERSONAL application (age 40, income "100000.00", no flags, pinned version 1)
acceptance_criteria.then: decision AUTO_APPROVE, score 740, reason_codes ["SCORE_MEETS_AUTO_APPROVE"], policy_version 1, status APPROVED, and one ApplicationApproved event is published

acceptance_criteria.given: age 30, income "60000.00", no flags (score 680, review band 600-699)
acceptance_criteria.then: decision MANUAL_REVIEW with ["SCORE_IN_REVIEW_BAND"] and status MANUAL_REVIEW
decision AUTO_REJECT with ["SCORE_BELOW_MIN"] and status REJECTED
decision AUTO_REJECT with ["AGE_OUT_OF_RANGE"] only

acceptance_criteria.given: application A submitted under version 1, version 2 (PERSONAL min_income "30000.00") approved afterwards, and application B submitted after that, both age 30 with income "26000.00"
acceptance_criteria.then: A uses policy_version 1 and is MANUAL_REVIEW (score 640), while B uses policy_version 2 and is AUTO_REJECT with ["INCOME_BELOW_MIN"]

acceptance_criteria.given: a DRAFT application, or an already decided one
acceptance_criteria.then: the DRAFT case is 409 NOT_SUBMITTED and the already-decided case is 409 ALREADY_DECIDED with the stored decision unchanged

title: Minimum-income violation
business_value: A hard policy floor on income must reject automatically with a clear, audit-visible reason rather than silently falling through to scoring.
scope_in: PolicyViolationException(INCOME_BELOW_MIN) raised by the rule engine below the product's min_income
the underwriting service catching it and persisting AUTO_REJECT/INCOME_BELOW_MIN

depends_on.reason: the income violation is persisted through the same decision-recording behavior as other outcomes

acceptance_criteria.then: it raises PolicyViolationException with code INCOME_BELOW_MIN
no exception is raised and the decision is MANUAL_REVIEW
it is 200 with AUTO_REJECT, reason_codes ["INCOME_BELOW_MIN"], status REJECTED, and a persisted decisions row

title: Manual review and override
business_value: A human underwriter (or, for an override, an admin) must be able to resolve a MANUAL_REVIEW or reverse an AUTO_REJECT, with every such action audited.
scope_in: POST .../review with outcome APPROVE|REJECT and a 1-500 character reason, UNDERWRITER only
POST .../override with reason_code (from the policy's override_reason_codes) and a comment, UNDERWRITER or ADMIN, on an AUTO_REJECT with no resolution yet
audit rows REVIEW_APPROVED, REVIEW_REJECTED, DECISION_OVERRIDDEN with before/after status
scope_out: overriding anything other than an AUTO_REJECT
listing/filtering applications across the portfolio (FR-10, deferred to M2)

depends_on.reason: review and override act on an existing decision row
review and override actions are audited

acceptance_criteria.when: UNDERWRITER user 3 POSTs {outcome:"APPROVE", reason:"Stable income, documents verified"}
acceptance_criteria.then: it is 200, status APPROVED, resolution MANUAL_REVIEW/APPROVED, an audit row REVIEW_APPROVED with actor 3, and an ApplicationApproved event

acceptance_criteria.when: they POST REJECT with a reason
acceptance_criteria.then: status REJECTED, audit row REVIEW_REJECTED, and no event

acceptance_criteria.when: ADMIN user 1 POSTs {reason_code:"COMPENSATING_FACTORS", comment:"Co-signed by parent; income verified"}
acceptance_criteria.then: it is 200, status APPROVED, the decision row still reads AUTO_REJECT, an audit row DECISION_OVERRIDDEN with actor 1, the reason code, the comment, before REJECTED/after APPROVED, and an event
the same outcome as AC3 with actor 3 in the audit row

acceptance_criteria.given: an application in MANUAL_REVIEW or already overridden, or a reason_code "FOO" or an empty comment, or review on an application not in MANUAL_REVIEW, or a CUSTOMER token
acceptance_criteria.then: it is 409 NOT_OVERRIDABLE, 422, 409 NOT_IN_REVIEW, and 403 respectively

title: Decision review and override UI
business_value: Gives an underwriter the score, reason codes, and policy context needed to resolve a MANUAL_REVIEW or decide an override, on desktop and mobile.
scope_in: a decision panel showing score, reason codes with customer-readable messages, and policy version
an override dialog requiring both a reason code and a comment before Submit enables
review Approve/Reject buttons disabled until a reason is entered
scope_out: the admin-only application list/filter view (FR-10, deferred to M2)

depends_on.reason: the decision UI calls these endpoints

acceptance_criteria.then: it shows score 680, the reason code with its message, and policy version 1; at 375x812 the panels stack with no horizontal scroll

acceptance_criteria.given: the override dialog on an AUTO_REJECT application
acceptance_criteria.when: the comment is empty or no reason code is chosen
acceptance_criteria.then: Submit is disabled; with both set it enables and success shows a confirmation
Approve and Reject are disabled

title: Create and approve policy versions
business_value: Lets a policy editor adjust thresholds without a code change, while keeping every approved version immutable and auditable, and letting only an admin activate a new one.
scope_in: POST /api/policies creating a new DRAFT version file, byte-identical predecessor
POST /api/policies/{version}/approve, ADMIN only, activating the highest-numbered APPROVED version
validation of rate/age/tenure/amount/score ranges before a file is written
no PUT/PATCH/DELETE route on /api/policies*; a DB trigger aborting any other UPDATE
scope_out: editing score weights through the policy editor
rolling back an approved policy version

depends_on.reason: creating version 2 bases on the seeded version 1 file
policy create/approve actions are audited
only POLICY_EDITOR/ADMIN may call these routes

acceptance_criteria.when: they POST /api/policies with base_version 1 and PERSONAL.min_income "30000.00"
acceptance_criteria.then: it is 201 with version 2, status DRAFT, file policy_v0002.json written, an audit row POLICY_CREATED, and the SHA-256 of policy_v0001.json unchanged
PERSONAL min_income is still "25000.00" and policy_version is 1
it is 200 APPROVED with approved_by 1, an audit row POLICY_APPROVED, and GET /api/products shows PERSONAL min_income "30000.00" with policy_version 2

acceptance_criteria.when: PUT, PATCH, or DELETE hits /api/policies/1, or a raw SQL UPDATE changes its thresholds
acceptance_criteria.then: the HTTP verbs return 405 and the SQL UPDATE aborts at the database
it is 403

acceptance_criteria.given: a change setting auto_reject_below_score 750 with auto_approve_min_score 700, or min_income "-1"
acceptance_criteria.then: it is 422 VALIDATION_ERROR naming the offending field and no file is written

scope_in: per-product threshold forms stacking in one column on mobile
inline validation (e.g. min_age < max_age) disabling Save until fixed
a draft-version confirmation after Save
scope_out: approving a version from this UI (admin action, out of this story's scope_in)

depends_on.reason: the policy editor UI calls these endpoints

acceptance_criteria.then: the product forms stack in one column with no horizontal scroll
an inline error appears before submit and the Save button is disabled
the page shows "Draft v2" and the new version appears in the list
